input.text: Dormant accounts are charged a maintenance fee of $5 per month. Classify accounts as dormant after 12 months without customer-initiated activity.
sources: Dormant accounts are charged a maintenance fee of $5 per month.

input.text: Regional managers may approve rate exceptions of up to 0.50%.
sources: Regional managers may approve rate exceptions of up to 0.50%.
A branch manager can lower a loan rate by no more than 0.25% as an exception.

input.text: Outgoing consumer and small business wire requests received after 3:00 PM Central are processed the next business day. Outgoing wires of $10,000 or more require a callback to the customer at a number already on file. Personal bankers may waive service fees up to $15 per account in a calendar year.

input.text: The records custodian must approve the destruction of any records in writing, in most cases. Account records are kept for 7 years after the account closes, in most cases.

input.text: Account records are kept for 7 years after the account closes. Retain closed account records for 5 years from the closing date. Records may be destroyed only with written approval from the records custodian.
